status: post-observation exploratory diagnostic; not historical source test or preregistered discovery
target: 55 source nonempty LP2 text segments concatenated, 12956 GP29 indices, including across-segment transitions exactly as source
model: For each of 1000 controls, choose exactly the observed 86 of 12955 transition positions uniformly; at those positions repeat the preceding rune, elsewhere draw uniformly from the other 28 rune indices. Initial rune uniform 0..28. Thus length, alphabet and adjacent equal-pair count are exact controls, while unigram frequencies are uniform only in expectation.
comparison: Report observed value, control mean/SD, central 95-percent range and empirical rank for each entropy. This checks whether the published first-order dip remains unusual after matching repeat scarcity; it is not a held-out entropy-rate or plaintext/key test.
limitations: Repeat count chosen after inspecting the source anomaly and fitted to the same manuscript. No exact unigram-count matching, page-specific variation, parameter-selection adjustment, PPM, held-out prediction, or original proposed 1000-filtered-controls campaign.
